title: Exchange Zstandard frames with built-in codecs
goal: Use the .NET 11 Zstandard stream or buffer API with explicit format negotiation, finalisation, reset and window limits.

selectionNotes: Use the .NET 11 Zstandard stream or buffer API with explicit format negotiation, finalisation, reset and window limits. Desktop/server examples; inspect complete constraints before use.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: This edition uses or relies on .NET 11 framework APIs/behaviour; .NET 10 is comparison-only.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build the declared net11.0 comparison with its matching SDK.

language.name: C#
language.reason: The canonical .NET 11 project selects its supported C# 15 default.

platforms: Desktop/server .NET platforms; authoring execution recorded on Windows. Browser/WASI excluded from these samples.
prerequisites: Use a net11.0 console project with LangVersion=15.0, implicit usings and the namespaces stated in the complete recipe. No additional package, workload, account or provider is required.
constraints: Zstandard is a distinct frame format; both ends must support it. The APIs moved into System.IO.Compression before RC2; do not use the removed preview namespace/package as a down-level route. Browser and WASI are unsupported. Quality=3 and WindowLog2=20 are deliberate example settings, not mandatory framework defaults. MaxWindowLog2 limits codec memory and does not cap total decompressed bytes; impose an independent output budget. AppendChecksum is a noncryptographic integrity choice, not authentication. A dictionary or SetPrefix changes the decoding contract and must be agreed and retained with its lifetime; this example uses neither and claims no dictionary interoperability. Reset is for independent frames, not continuation; dispose all codec resources. Finite buffer helpers require Done and full consumption; handle other statuses explicitly in an incremental implementation. No external archive-tool, native ABI, trimming or AOT compatibility is established.
stabilityLimitations: Verified with SDK 11.0.100-rc.2.26504.105; RC2 execution is not GA verification.

evidence.scope: Actual .NET 10 Windows compilation/execution: fresh Deflate/ZLib/GZip stream round trips and no-write empty-output baseline. Built-in Zstandard is explicitly unavailable and its stub is tested. No mocks, cross-compilation or GA proof.

RC2 stream and buffer codecs restore empty/nonempty original messages, including reuse after Reset. Compilation resolves no NuGet packages: the actual ref/net11.0 framework asset contains the APIs. No .NET 10 package-asset support is inferred. Actual Windows compilation/execution; no mocks, cross-compilation or GA proof.

humanProof.scope: Bounded desktop/server archive and codec checks run locally without external providers or UI. No extra native/device or external-tool interoperability claim.
